reaction.policy: Only dated institutional steps; leader reactions require all seated lists or none.
reaction.gap: Election-night statements were not collected for all lists; none is selected.

entries.noteEn: The President counted ten Joint List recommendations; Ahmad Tibi's letter excluded Balad's three MKs at their request.

cites.quote: 55 המליצו על נתניהו, 54 על גנץ - 11 לא המליצו על אף מועמד
the recommendation is in the name of ten MKs and not 13

notes: Consultations were held on 22–23 September 2019. Ahmad Tibi wrote at the Balad MKs' request that the recommendation excluded them; the President counted ten Joint List MKs.

events.textEn: Rivlin tasked Benjamin Netanyahu with forming a government.
events.textHe: ריבלין הטיל על בנימין נתניהו להרכיב ממשלה.

cites.quote: President Reuven Rivlin on Wednesday tasked Benjamin Netanyahu, the Likud party leader, with forming Israel’s next government

events.textEn: Netanyahu returned the mandate without forming a government.
events.textHe: נתניהו החזיר את המנדט בלי שהרכיב ממשלה.

cites.quote: returned the mandate to form a government to President Reuven Rivlin

events.textEn: Rivlin tasked Benny Gantz with forming a government for 28 days.
events.textHe: ריבלין הטיל על בני גנץ להרכיב ממשלה בתוך 28 ימים.

cites.quote: Rivlin officially mandates Gantz with the task

events.textEn: Gantz returned the mandate without forming a government.
events.textHe: גנץ החזיר את המנדט בלי שהרכיב ממשלה.

cites.quote: handing the mandate back to President Reuven Rivlin after 28 days

events.textEn: The Knesset’s 21-day period to propose a candidate began, ending at midnight on 11 December.
events.textHe: החלה תקופת 21 הימים שבה הכנסת רשאית להציע מועמד, עד חצות ב־11 בדצמבר.

cites.quote: which begins Thursday and ends at midnight on December 11

notes: This is expiry of the parliamentary nomination period, not a third personal mandate.
events.textEn: The 21-day period ended at midnight without a candidate supported by 61 MKs.
events.textHe: תקופת 21 הימים הסתיימה בחצות ללא מועמד שנתמך ב־61 חברי כנסת.

cites.quote: With no Knesset member having gained the support of 61 MKs by the midnight deadline

events.textEn: The Knesset passed a dissolution law and advanced the next election to 2 March 2020. No government was formed.
events.textHe: הכנסת קיבלה חוק התפזרות והקדימה את הבחירות הבאות ל־2 במרס 2020. לא הוקמה ממשלה.

cites.quote: the Knesset passed a law to dissolve the 22nd Knesset
MKs eventually finalized a bill setting the elections for March 2

conflicts.about: Formal dissolution mechanism after the 21-day period

values.value: The dissolution law passed before presidential notification, advancing the election by eight days.

conflicts.resolution: Use the academic legal account for the formal mechanism; separately record the failed parliamentary nomination period. Do not describe it solely as automatic dissolution.

events.textEn: Attorney General Avichai Mandelblit announced his decision to indict Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on bribery, fraud and breach of trust charges.
events.textHe: היועץ המשפטי לממשלה אביחי מנדלבליט הודיע על החלטתו להגיש כתב אישום נגד ראש הממשלה בנימין נתניהו בגין שוחד, מרמה והפרת אמונים.

cites.quote: ביום 21.11.2019 הודיע היועץ המשפטי לממשלה על החלטתו להגיש כתב אישום
announced his decision to indict Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu

notes: Decision announcement, distinct from the court filing on 28 January 2020. No guilt finding is asserted.

events.textEn: US President Donald Trump presented his administration’s Israeli–Palestinian peace proposal.
events.textHe: נשיא ארה״ב דונלד טראמפ הציג את הצעת ממשלו להסדר ישראלי–פלסטיני.

cites.quote: 28 Jan. The USA publishes its long-awaited plan
Jan 28, 2020 Trump Administration Proposes Peace Plan
